guides.name: Wanted Level & Heat
guides.summary: Read police clues and understand what follows you after a chase.
body: Heat adds identifying clues alongside wanted stars. Reports describe camera footage, accomplice, clothing, face, weapon and vehicle evidence.
An escape can mean breaking the description as well as leaving the search area. Clothing, a visible weapon and a recognized vehicle are separate clues.

Preview reports describe separating the protagonists as a response to an accomplice clue, while an arrest can still end the shared escape. Exact timers and guaranteed escape recipes require released-game testing.

guides.name: Relationship Status
guides.summary: How the partnership develops outside the next job.
body: Reports describe ordinary activities together, including kayaking and beach walks, alongside the criminal partnership.
Messages, affection and a visible Hold Hands prompt give the relationship small moments between jobs. The precise thresholds for those interactions have not been published.
The relationship is separate from each character’s Criminal Profile. Previews describe romantic and partners-in-crime approaches; specific ending consequences are not established.

guides.name: Criminal Profile
guides.summary: Two protagonists, two evolving criminal reputations.
body: Jason and Lucia each have a separate Criminal Profile. It describes behavioral patterns rather than the immediate police pursuit or their shared relationship.
Developer interviews distinguish controlled criminal work from repeated unnecessary escalation. The two characters’ profiles can diverge during one playthrough.
Preview commentary reports Professional, Aggressive, Violent and Psycho states. Final thresholds, recovery rules and exact mission or ending effects have not been published.

world.intro: A Florida-inspired state with Vice City at its urban heart. Follow the coastline, island chain, wetlands and inland industry into six officially featured regions.

sections.title: Vice City
sections.label: City & coast
body: Beachfront nightlife, Ocean Beach and the urban districts of Vice City.

sections.title: Leonida Keys
sections.label: Islands & ocean
body: Island communities, marinas and Brian’s boat-yard smuggling operation.

sections.title: Grassrivers
sections.label: Wetlands
body: Wetlands, airboats and alligator country.

sections.title: Port Gellhorn
sections.label: Coastal region
body: A coastal community of low-cost motels and roadside businesses.

sections.title: Ambrosia
sections.label: Inland region
body: Industrial Leonida, with sugar production and biker activity.

sections.title: Mount Kalaga National Park
sections.label: National park
body: Forested national park, mountain trails and off-road terrain.

sections.title: Counties and towns
sections.label: COMMUNITY GEOGRAPHY
body: Community references organize Leonida into Vice-Dale, Leonard, Ambrosia, Kelly, Mariana and Lummox counties. Vice City anchors Vice-Dale; Port Gellhorn is associated with Kelly, and the Keys and Grassrivers with Mariana.
The evidence is mixed: Lummox is identified through leaked material in GTABase’s list. County borders remain community reconstructions.

sections.title: The road-trip notebook
sections.label: HIGHWAYS / CONNECTIONS
body: The community road catalog includes Interstate 97, U.S. Route 1, Leonida State Route 1A, Vice-Dale County Road 561 and Forest Route 88.
Recorded signs and names help connect landmarks, but do not verify every junction or the final road layout.

sections.title: Catalan Bay
sections.label: WATERFRONT / REAL-WORLD INFLUENCE
body: Community mappers identify Catalan Bay in Vice-Dale County with Florida’s Biscayne Bay. Its waterfront sits among the port, causeways and islands.
The comparison explains the setting; it is not a one-to-one navigation guide to the real bay.

sections.title: Florida through a fictional lens
sections.label: INFLUENCE / TRIVIA
body: Vice City reflects Miami, while Leonida draws from a wider Florida palette. The geography combines city beaches, islands, wetlands, industrial towns and wild country.
Real-world comparisons reveal architectural and scenic inspirations. The game rearranges those influences into its own state.
